title: HOSE: Hierarchical Orthogonal Subspace Erasure for Concept Unlearning in Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.30592v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate harmful or sensitive content, such as pornographic or violent imagery, raising serious security concerns. Model editing has recently emerged as an efficient approach to mitigate this issue. It modifies pretrained models with minimal parameter updates to alter specific concepts while preserving overall model capabilities. However, due to the entangled representations of different concepts in diffusion models, direct modifications inevitably disrupt non-target concepts. Meanwhile, U-Net's hierarchical heterogeneity hinders unified strategies from balancing erasure and quality. To address these issues, we propose Hierarchical Orthogonal Subspace Erasure (HOSE). This method projects parameter updates into the subspace orthogonal to general knowledge, thereby eliminating interference with non-target concepts. translated_title: HOSE：面向扩散模型概念遗忘的分层正交子空间擦除方法
translated_abstract: 文本到图像扩散模型可能生成有害或敏感的内容，例如色情或暴力图像，引发了严重的安全担忧。模型编辑近期成为一种缓解该问题的高效方法，它通过最小的参数更新来修改预训练模型，从而改变特定概念，同时保持模型的整体能力。然而，由于扩散模型中不同概念的表示相互纠缠，直接修改不可避免地会干扰非目标概念。同时，U-Net 的分层异质性使得统一策略难以在擦除效果与生成质量之间取得平衡。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了分层正交子空间擦除（HOSE）。该方法将参数更新投影到与通用知识正交的子空间中，从而消除对非目标概念的干扰。考虑到 U-Net 架构的分层异质性，我们进一步提出了（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出HOSE方法，通过将参数更新投影到与通用知识正交的子空间并结合U-Net分层异质性设计分层策略，在避免破坏非目标概念和整体生成能力的前提下，实现对扩散模型中有害概念的有效擦除。
en_tdlr: HOSE erases harmful concepts in diffusion models by projecting parameter updates into subspaces orthogonal to general knowledge, with hierarchical strategies tailored to U-Net's heterogeneity, preserving non-target concepts and overall generation quality.
